merged.title: Level 18: func_L18_002D7310 to size exact (77.9% fuzzy)
merged.author: Lynder063
merged.untrustedBody:
## Summary

- `func_L18_002D7310` (level 18, 484 bytes) goes from a size mismatch (488) to size-exact with 107 bytes off, so its fuzzy score in the report goes from 0 % to 77.9 %. It is staged in `nonmatching/`, not landed.
- What got it there:
  - The post-call code is written in both branches, so gcc crossjumps the two calls into retail's single shared `jal`.
  - Prototype B for `func_L00_0025F4A8` fixes the argument order. Exact callers in l13, l17 and shared already use it: 108 bytes off against 124 (A) and 137 (C).
  - `((unsigned char *)moby)[0xA4] = 0xFF`. Through a `char *`, gcc turns 0xFF into -1 and shares it with the later `-1` stack argument.
- What is left: the scheduling order of the argument setup, and which of `$2`/`$3` the shared tail uses.

## Not matched, and why (level 18)

- `func_L18_002D9C78`/`002D9C90`, `002D9440`/`002D9460`, `002E0F90`, `002F1420`/`002F1444`: each is one real function that the catalogue split into two. The first half branches into the second. C

merged.title: Port 9 shared level functions from Lombyte PR #66 (+2 near-misses)
merged.author: Lynder063
merged.untrustedBody:
## Summary

Lombyte's [PR #66](https://github.com/mateuszklysz/Lombyte/pull/66) (merged 2026-10-03) landed C for many resident and shared-overlay functions of the US build. I paired its functions with ours using `tools/lombyte.py map`, which finds 202 matched there and not here. I took the smallest shared-level ones, translated the names and globals to PAL, and checked each with `try_func.py`. Nine are exact:

| Function | Bytes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `func_L00_002EB3A0` | 72 | clears a moby's work block and re-runs its setup |
| `func_L00_0025A868` | 36 | tests whether a moby's linked object has a non-zero field at +8 |
| `func_L00_002E99E4` | 12 | stores a float into a moby field at +0xB4 |
| `func_L00_002AAE20` | 92 | moves the tracked class 0x5F3 moby to a position, creating it first if needed |
| `func_L00_002DCD40` | 104 | calls the callback a moby's class defines at +0x10, unless the moby is deleted |
| `func_L00_00261848` | 144 | marks a planet as discovered and appen

merged.title: Level code: 145 functions (19.46%), Level 16, near misses restaged, parallel salvage
merged.author: Veradictus
merged.untrustedBody:
## Summary
- **145 level functions exact**:
  - 125 from the Level 12-18 waves and near-miss rounds;
  - 12 on Level 16 (Kalebo III), matched by the GPT agent;
  - 8 adapted from Lombyte (MIT), credited in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
- **Progress vs. upstream:** 16.96% → 19.46% of code; functions 2,609 → 2,744 of 5,109.
- **Near misses:** 529 staged in `nonmatching/`, each with its closest candidate and the remaining differences. Each one is flagged when it can't land as written, and keeps its last measured result when a neighbour's landing breaks its build.
- **Tools:**
  - `overlay_check` accepts retail's copy for `%hi`/`%lo` pairs in functions that exist as several identical copies.
  - `wave.py salvage` runs several levels at once.
  - `lombyte.py` and `names.py` find Lombyte's report now that it's published by CI.
  - The wave and name tools run on Python 3.9.
  - The long-function budget is now 30 runs.
- **Docs:** new codegen levers in `docs/QUEUE.md`.
- **Merge:** inc

merged.author: Lynder063
merged.untrustedBody: Brings in PR #21 (Level 16, ported relatives, US→PAL map, editor tooling), which conflicted after #18 and #19 were merged. Its conflicts were all in generated or staged near-miss files: for `func_L18_002D7310` and `func_L00_00205B50` the version on `main` stays, the staged files of functions that are now C are dropped, and the near-miss index and `progress/report.json` are regenerated.
